facts.fact: CBN's Director of Other Financial Institutions Supervision, Yemi Solaja, said the bank upgraded the operating licences of Moniepoint MFB, OPay, Kuda Bank, PalmPay and Paga to national after they met requirements including KYC.

KYC is named but no check against the national ID is stated.

facts.fact: Business Post reports OPay, Moniepoint, PalmPay, Kuda and Paga hold CBN licences upgraded to national, with CBN's Yemi Solaja saying their operations are already nationwide.
